{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f'Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}')

print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_summary)}')"}
